subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a shared session-scoped `/stream` command with `SessionEntry.streamingMode` and Telegram/Discord/Slack as the MVP channel set after the code blockers are fixed?
rationale: The PR adds a new cross-channel command, durable session-state field, and plugin capability surface; repository policy and the linked issue labels treat this as product/API-sensitive rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Fix the session-mode suppression bugs, require current-head channel proof, and then land this command shape as the canonical solution for the linked feature request.

options.title: Narrow the MVP
options.body: Keep the PR open but ask the contributor to reduce the initial surface, such as one channel or a smaller command mode set, before product acceptance.

options.title: Decline core command
options.body: Close or redirect the work if maintainers decide streaming mode control should remain static config or plugin-specific rather than a shared core command.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the session-mode suppression bugs, require current-head channel proof, and then land this command shape as the canonical solution for the linked feature request.

likelyOwner.reason: The history pass points to prior ownership of shared progress-draft and command/session surfaces affected by the product choice.
